```{=html}
<style>
  #albany-wrap { display:flex; gap:12px; height:78vh; min-height:480px; }
  #albany-side { width:250px; flex:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; font-size:.9rem; }
  #albany-side input[type=search] { width:100%; padding:6px 8px; box-sizing:border-box; }
  #albany-list { flex:1; overflow-y:auto; border:1px solid #8884; border-radius:4px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; }
  #albany-list li { padding:4px 8px; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
  #albany-list li:hover { background:#8882; }
  #albany-list li.sel { background:#c9a22744; font-weight:600; }
  #albany-list li.off { opacity:.55; }
  #albany-list img { width:18px; height:18px; object-fit:contain; flex:none; }
  #albany-list small { opacity:.65; margin-left:auto; }
  #albany-map { flex:1; min-width:0; background:#d9d2c0; border-radius:4px; }
  #albany-edit { display:none; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  #albany-edit button { padding:4px 8px; }
  #albany-status { font-size:.8rem; opacity:.75; }

  /* arms medallions */
  .pin { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:calc(var(--s) * var(--k)); height:calc(var(--s) * var(--k));
       transform:translate(-50%,-50%); transition:transform .12s; }
.pin img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; display:block;
           filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #000a); }
.pin.noimg { background:var(--c); border-radius:50%; }

  /* hover card */
  .albany-tip { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; max-width:320px; white-space:normal; padding:2px; }
  .albany-tip img { width:64px; height:64px; object-fit:contain; flex:none; }
  .albany-tip b { font-size:1.05rem; }
  .albany-tip .bl { font-style:italic; opacity:.85; }
  .albany-tip .where { font-size:.8rem; opacity:.65; margin-top:3px; }
  .leaflet-tooltip.albany { border:1px solid #6b5a2e; background:#fbf7ea; color:#2a2418; }

  @media (max-width:700px) { #albany-wrap { flex-direction:column-reverse; height:auto; }
    #albany-map { height:65vh; } #albany-list { max-height:180px; } #albany-side { width:auto; } }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  // ---- settings -----------------------------------------------------------
  const MAP_IMG = 'Map%20of%20Albany.png';
  const ARMS    = 'arms/';                    // folder containing the .svg files
  const EDIT    = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('edit');
  const DRAFT   = 'albany-map-draft-v1';
  const REALM_COLOUR = { PICTONY:'#2f6aa3', BRYDONY:'#b3392f', NORSKANY:'#6a4c93', SAESONY:'#2e7d4f' };

  // ---- data ---------------------------------------------------------------
  function parse(text) {
    const rows = []; let realm = '', duchy = '', county = '';
    for (let line of text.split('\n')) {
      line = line.trim();
      if (!line || line.startsWith('//')) continue;
      const h = line.match(/^(#{1,3})\s*(.*)$/);
      if (h) {
        const [title, ruler = '', blazon = ''] = h[2].split('|').map(s => s.trim());
        const lvl = h[1].length;
        if (lvl === 1) { realm = title; duchy = county = ''; }
        else if (lvl === 2) { duchy = title; county = ''; }
        else county = title;
        rows.push({ h: lvl, title, ruler, blazon });
        continue;
      }
      const [name, ruler = '', blazon = '', file = '', x = '', y = ''] = line.split('|').map(s => s.trim());
      rows.push({ name, ruler, blazon, file, realm, duchy, county,
                  x: x === '' ? null : +x, y: y === '' ? null : +y });
    }
    return rows;
  }
  function serialise(rows) {
    return rows.map(r => r.h
      ? '#'.repeat(r.h) + ' ' + [r.title, r.ruler, r.blazon].join('|').replace(/\|+$/, '')
      : [r.name, r.ruler, r.blazon, r.file, r.x ?? '', r.y ?? ''].join('|').replace(/\|+$/, '')
    ).join('\n').replace(/\n(# )/g, '\n\n$1') + '\n';
  }
  const armsUrl = e => ARMS + (e.file || e.name.replace(/ /g, '_') + '.svg');
  const isCapital = e => /[A-Z]/.test(e.name) && e.name === e.name.toUpperCase();
  const esc = s => s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));

  // ---- start --------------------------------------------------------------
  const img = new Image();
  const imgReady = new Promise((ok, bad) => { img.onload = ok; img.onerror = bad; });
  img.src = MAP_IMG;
  Promise.all([document.getElementById('albany-data').textContent, imgReady])
    .then(([text]) => init(parse(text)))
    .catch(err => { document.getElementById('albany-status').textContent = 'Could not load the map image'; });

  function init(rows) {
    const W = img.naturalWidth, H = img.naturalHeight;
    const places = rows.filter(r => !r.h);
    const key = p => p.county + '/' + p.name;

    if (EDIT) {                                   // draft positions override the file in edit mode
      try {
        const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DRAFT) || '{}');
        places.forEach(p => { if (d[key(p)]) [p.x, p.y] = d[key(p)]; });
      } catch (e) {}
      document.getElementById('albany-edit').style.display = 'flex';
    }
    const saveDraft = () => {
      try { localStorage.setItem(DRAFT, JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(
        places.filter(p => p.x != null).map(p => [key(p), [p.x, p.y]])))); } catch (e) {}
    };

    const map = L.map('albany-map', { crs: L.CRS.Simple, zoomSnap: .25, zoomDelta: .5,
      wheelPxPerZoomLevel: 100, attributionControl: false, minZoom: -10, maxZoom: 10 });
    const bounds = [[0, 0], [H, W]];
    L.imageOverlay(MAP_IMG, bounds).addTo(map);
    const fit = map.getBoundsZoom(bounds);
    map.setMinZoom(fit - 1); map.setMaxZoom(fit + 4);
    map.setView([H / 2, W / 2], fit);
    map.setMaxBounds(L.latLngBounds(bounds).pad(.3));
    const mapEl = document.getElementById('albany-map');

    const toLL = p => L.latLng(H * (1 - p.y / 100), W * p.x / 100);
    const fromLL = ll => ({ x: +(ll.lng / W * 100).toFixed(2), y: +((1 - ll.lat / H) * 100).toFixed(2) });

    let size = 20;
    function resize() {
      size = Math.max(14, Math.min(90, 20 * Math.pow(1.45, map.getZoom() - fit)));
      mapEl.style.setProperty('--s', size + 'px');
      places.forEach(p => {
        if (p.m) p.m.getTooltip().options.offset = L.point(0, -size * (isCapital(p) ? .75 : .5) - 4);
      });
    }
    map.on('zoom', resize);

    function tipHtml(p) {
      return `<div class="albany-tip"><img src="${armsUrl(p)}" alt="" onerror="this.remove()">
        <div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><br>${p.ruler ? esc(p.ruler) : '<span style="opacity:.55">Ruler not recorded</span>'}
        ${p.blazon ? `<div class="bl">${esc(p.blazon)}</div>` : ''}
        <div class="where">${[p.county, p.duchy, p.realm].filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(' · ')}</div></div></div>`;
    }

    function addMarker(p) {
      const col = REALM_COLOUR[p.realm] || '#555';
      const icon = L.divIcon({ className: '', iconSize: [0, 0],
        html: `<div class="pin ${isCapital(p) ? 'cap' : ''}" style="--c:${col};--k:${isCapital(p) ? 1.5 : 1}">
               <img src="${armsUrl(p)}" alt="" onerror="this.parentNode.classList.add('noimg');this.remove()"></div>` });
      p.m = L.marker(toLL(p), { icon, draggable: EDIT, keyboard: false, riseOnHover: true })
        .bindTooltip(tipHtml(p), { className: 'albany', direction: 'top', opacity: 1 })
        .addTo(map);
      p.m.on('dragend', () => { Object.assign(p, fromLL(p.m.getLatLng())); saveDraft(); refresh(); });
    }
    places.forEach(p => { if (p.x != null) addMarker(p); });
    resize();

    // ---- sidebar ----------------------------------------------------------
    const listEl = document.getElementById('albany-list'), search = document.getElementById('albany-search');
    const status = document.getElementById('albany-status');
    let sel = null;
    function refresh() {
      const q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      listEl.innerHTML = '';
      places.filter(p => !q || (p.name + p.ruler + p.county).toLowerCase().includes(q)).forEach(p => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = (p === sel ? 'sel ' : '') + (p.x == null && !EDIT ? 'off' : '');
        li.innerHTML = `<img src="${armsUrl(p)}" alt="" onerror="this.style.visibility='hidden'">
                        <span>${esc(p.name)}</span><small>${p.x == null ? (EDIT ? 'unplaced' : '') : esc(p.county)}</small>`;
        li.onclick = () => {
          if (EDIT) { sel = p; refresh(); if (p.m) map.panTo(p.m.getLatLng()); return; }
          if (p.m) { map.flyTo(p.m.getLatLng(), Math.max(map.getZoom(), fit + 2), { duration: .6 }); p.m.openTooltip(); }
        };
        listEl.appendChild(li);
      });
      const n = places.filter(p => p.x != null).length;
      status.textContent = EDIT
        ? `${n} of ${places.length} placed. Pick a place in the list, then click the map to put it there. Drag a marker to adjust.`
        : (n < places.length ? `${n} of ${places.length} places mapped so far.` : '');
    }
    search.oninput = refresh;
    refresh();

    // ---- edit mode --------------------------------------------------------
    if (EDIT) {
      map.on('click', ev => {
        if (!sel) return;
        Object.assign(sel, fromLL(ev.latlng));
        if (sel.m) sel.m.setLatLng(toLL(sel)); else { addMarker(sel); resize(); }
        saveDraft();
        const i = places.indexOf(sel);
        sel = places.slice(i + 1).find(p => p.x == null) || places.find(p => p.x == null) || null;
        refresh();
      });
      const data = () => serialise(rows);
      document.getElementById('e-copy').onclick = () =>
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(data()).then(() => status.textContent = 'Copied. Paste over the contents of the albany-data block in map.qmd.');
      document.getElementById('e-save').onclick = () => {
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data()], { type: 'text/plain' }));
        a.download = 'locations.txt'; a.click();
      };
      document.getElementById('e-reset').onclick = () => {
        if (confirm('Clear the saved draft and reload?')) { localStorage.removeItem(DRAFT); location.reload(); }
      };
    }
  }
})();
</script>
```
